_comment: Creator campaign landing pages. Adding a creator = add one entry to `creators` below; creator-link.njk generates /<slug>/ automatically. No template edits, no route registration.
_providerTokenNote: Apple provider token from App Store Connect (Analytics > Acquisition > Campaigns). It is the SAME value for every campaign, so it lives here once. While empty, pages emit the plain product URL instead of a malformed ?pt=&ct= link.
